title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction: The page is a recapitulation ('Récapitulation') of the data of a 'déploiement' (unfolding or resolution) of a stratified space indexed by a poset I, assumed finite. The data are: (a) spaces Σ_i for i∈I, the resolved strata, which become compact manifolds with boundary or corners in the equisingular case; (b) spaces Σ_ij for i<j; (c) maps s_ij: Σ_ij→Σ_i and b_ij: Σ_ij→Σ_j. Σ_ij plays the role of the 'link bundle' of stratum i inside stratum j: s_ij is the projection to the lower stratum and b_ij embeds it as a boundary face of Σ_j. The conditions are as follows. (a) b_ij is a closed embedding ('plongement fermé', corrected from 'immersion bordante'), so Σ_ij is identified with a closed subspace of Σ_j. (b) Σ_ik∩Σ_jk=∅ in Σ_k when i,j<k are incomparable; boundary faces meet only for comparable strata. A margin NB says this is equivalent to: in the ordered set Σ=⨿Σ_i, each Σ_{<x} is totally ordered. (c) For i<j<k put Σ_ijk=Σ_ik∩Σ_jk⊂Σ_k (a codimension-2 corner indexed by the chain i<j<k), and require that inside Σ_jk one has Σ_ijk = s_jk^{-1}(b_ij(Σ_ij)). This yields the commutative hexagon (41) with two cartesian squares. The upper square is Σ_ijk = Σ_ik ×_{Σ_k} Σ_jk, an intersection of two faces. The lower square is Σ_ijk = Σ_jk ×_{Σ_j} Σ_ij, the restriction of the link bundle of j to the face coming from i. Commutativity of the outer hexagon means s_ik|Σ_ijk = s_ij∘s_jk|Σ_ijk. This is the compactified/resolved form of Mather's control condition π_i∘π_j=π_i. The hooked arrows are closed bordant inclusions (boundary faces). The plain arrows (s) are to be proper and fibrant (locally trivial, fibred in manifolds with boundary) in the equisingular case. The previous page treats the special case of a single space ('situation-W', diagram (40)). The next page adds transversality of the boundary faces at a point (corners) and repackages everything as Σ=⨿Σ_i and Σ^(1)=⨿Σ_ij, with (s,b): Σ^(1)→Σ×Σ the graph of a strict order whose lower sets are totally ordered. In other words, a déploiement is a topological strict poset over I, with spaces of chains Σ(n). Purpose: to axiomatize the 'déploiement' of a stratified space. This is the manifold-with-corners model that Grothendieck in the Esquisse conjectures to be equivalent to tame stratified spaces with conical neighbourhoods.
errors: No mathematical error. Condition b) is correct for the resolved picture, though it would be false for naive closures: in a square, two incomparable edges meet at a vertex, but after resolving the vertex first their faces in the resolved 2-cell no longer meet. This is exactly as in Melrose/ALMP fibered corners.
The identity in c) should read Σ_ijk = s_jk^{-1}(Σ_ij), with Σ_ij ⊂ Σ_j via b_ij, as the lower cartesian square of (41) shows. The machine reading 'b_ij^{-1}(Σ_ij)' is not type-correct.

ideas.what: Poset-indexed data (Σ_i, Σ_ij, s_ij, b_ij) with Σ_ij a closed boundary face of Σ_j and s_ij: Σ_ij→Σ_i a proper fibration: a resolution of a stratified space into manifolds with boundary or corners.
ideas.modern_name: Thom–Mather resolution / manifold with fibered corners / iterated fibration structure (déploiement)
ideas.usually_credited_to: A. Verona (Stratified Mappings, LNM 1102, 1984); Brasselet–Hector–Saralegi (1992); Melrose; Albin–Leichtnam–Mazzeo–Piazza (2012); 'unzipping' in Ayala–Francis–Tanaka (2017)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 (théorie des déploiements, stated programmatically without explicit axioms)

ideas.what: Boundary faces Σ_ik, Σ_jk of Σ_k are disjoint unless i,j are comparable. Equivalently, in the total space Σ=⨿Σ_i, every Σ_{<x} is totally ordered.
ideas.modern_name: Boundary hypersurfaces of a manifold with fibered corners intersect only for comparable strata

ideas.what: Hexagon (41) with two cartesian squares: codimension-2 corners Σ_ijk = Σ_ik∩Σ_jk = s_jk^{-1}(Σ_ij), and s_ik = s_ij∘s_jk on Σ_ijk.
ideas.modern_name: Compatibility of boundary fibrations at corners (resolved Mather control conditions π_i∘π_j=π_i)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Mather (1970) for control data; Verona and ALMP for the resolved version

ideas.what: Repackaging (completed on the next page) as a topological strict poset Σ=⨿Σ_i, with Σ^(1) the space of pairs x<y and face maps s,b.
ideas.modern_name: Stratified space as a topological poset / simplicial space of chains (cf. exit-path and unzipping models)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ayala–Francis–Tanaka; Lurie (exit paths, Higher Algebra appendix A)

missed.claim: An explicit axiomatization of the 'déploiement' (Thom–Mather resolution / fibered-corner structure) indexed by an arbitrary finite poset, dated 1981–82. It includes the incomparability-disjointness axiom and the cartesian hexagon of corners. This is contemporaneous with or slightly earlier than Verona's resolution and three decades before ALMP's 'iterated fibration structures'. The literature credits Verona, Brasselet–Hector–Saralegi, Melrose and ALMP; Grothendieck's explicit axioms are unpublished (the Esquisse only announces a theory of déploiements).
missed.quote: Σ_{i,k} ∩ Σ_{j,k} = ∅ si i,j non comparables ... On a donc, pour i<j<k, un diagramme commutatif hexagonal (41)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical priority and independent origin of the fibered-corners resolution of stratified spaces, which is now central in analysis on singular spaces (ALMP signature, intersection homology). It also shows what Grothendieck's tame-topology programme concretely meant.

missed.claim: The NB reformulates the axioms as an order structure on Σ=⨿Σ_i, and the next page continues this as the graph of a strict order with totally ordered lower sets. This treats a resolved stratified space as a topological poset over I whose spaces of chains form a simplicial space. That links déploiements to the simplicial/∞-categorical (exit-path, unzipping) models of stratified spaces.
missed.quote: les ensembles Σ_{<x} sont totalement ordonnés
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is an early form of the idea, developed in AFT and Lurie, that a stratified space is a category-like object over its stratum poset. It is a possible precursor for comparing conically smooth structures with resolution data.

deep.surprise_reason: These are fully explicit axioms for the resolved (fibered-corner) model of a stratified space over a general poset, with the correct and non-obvious disjointness axiom and the corner hexagon. The structure is now standard (Verona, ALMP), and the Esquisse announced déploiements, so it is a notable unpublished early formulation rather than an unknown result.
transcription_corrections: The left-margin NB likely reads 'NB Condition b) équivaut à dire que dans l'ensemble ordonné Σ = ⨿Σ_i, les ensembles Σ_{<x} sont totalement ordonnés', not 'ignorée si l'on ordonne... tout c) ordonnés'.
In c), 'Vraie dans' should be 'Vu dans Σ_jk :' and the identity is Σ_ijk = s_jk^{-1}(Σ_ij), consistent with the lower cartesian square, not b_ij^{-1}(Σ_ij).
The annotation under 'fermées' is probably '(cf plus bas)' rather than 'et plus fortes'.
The top-left diagonal margin plausibly begins 'C'est la structure ensembliste sous-jacente (f. 26/27) plus une structure ... telle que ... Σ_{<x} ... I_{<i}'; 'amissigendus' is a misreading.
